plugins.name: devil-review
plugins.description: The devil is in the details — adversarial code review that finds the subtle bugs, race conditions, and violated invariants hiding in your diff.

plugins.name: radar
plugins.description: Track competitors, upstream tools and dependencies — release radar for your repo

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: Conventional commit plugin — delegates message generation to a Haiku subagent for cost-efficient, format-enforced git commits.

plugins.name: human-voice
plugins.description: Ghostwriting style guard — loaded before drafting any text a human will read as the user's own words, so it doesn't read as AI-written.

plugins.name: launch-qa
plugins.description: Phased, multi-session pre-launch QA for apps with a web UI — flow inventory, coverage map, edge-case seed, hands-on tours, severity-ranked findings, test-first fixes — that collects its own lessons from every run.

plugins.name: setup-hygiene
plugins.description: Audit an agent setup — global, project and its board — for stale, wasteful or contradictory pieces against today's vendor docs; evidence-backed proposals, applied only on the owner's approval, with a decision ledger.
